name: 圆粒白鸡头米炖煮款
description: 米白圆粒鸡头米芡实，颗粒饱满整齐，需浸泡后慢炖，煮粥煲汤炒制皆宜

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless warm off-white #F7F2E8 for packshots, deep olive-green panels #1E3B33 for benefit and infographic screens, one warm terracotta band #E39A5F as accent, dusty blush cards #F7DEDA for spec and pain panels, natural woven bamboo mat #C79A62 for overhead flat lays
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft diffused studio lighting with a gentle top key, soft contact shadows, warm 4800K on set, subtle rim on the round beads, never harsh speculars and never a plastic sheen
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte off-white ceramic bowls with a thin dark rim, woven bamboo mat #C79A62, dark walnut wood board #3B2A20, warm oak table #B9895E, plain matte paper
styleLock.typography: single modern geometric sans-serif for headline and labels only, no calligraphy, no brush script, no serif display; antique gold #D9A441 stays reserved for thin divider lines and small circular chip outlines
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line circular badges and small rounded pill labels in one warm accent, uniform stroke weight
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale across the set; kernels always read as uniform round matte beads with a tiny dark hilum dot, never glossy or candy-like
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm oriental pantry-goods ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm off-white background #F7F2E8, deep olive-green panel #1E3B33, terracotta orange accent #C96A2B and dusty blush card #F7DEDA, with antique gold #D9A441 reserved for thin divider lines and small circular chip outlines; warm tone; soft diffused studio lighting with a gentle top key, soft contact shadows, warm 4800K, a subtle rim on the round beads, no harsh speculars and no plastic sheen; single modern geometric sans-serif for headline and labels only with no calligraphy and no brush script; consistent thin-line circular badges and rounded pill labels; clean food photography mixed with minimal infographic elements on deep green panels; stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale with kernels always reading as uniform round matte beads with a tiny dark hilum dot; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
